title: Condition-neutral final deliverable rubric
input_boundary: Review final.md only. Do not inspect workspaces, state files, registries, prompts, model metadata, or condition labels.

dimensions.name: evidence_accuracy_and_boundaries
dimensions.question: Are important claims supported and are source claims, interpretation, judgment, and uncertainty kept distinct?

dimensions.name: mechanism_and_synthesis
dimensions.question: Does the deliverable explain mechanisms and tradeoffs across evidence instead of listing sources or actors?

dimensions.name: counter_evidence
dimensions.question: Are strong alternative explanations, failure modes, and adoption frictions integrated into the argument?

dimensions.name: uncertainty
dimensions.question: Are material unknowns and evidence limitations stated clearly without dissolving the main judgment?

dimensions.name: depth_and_coverage
dimensions.question: Does the deliverable cover the requested units at enough depth for the stated reader?

dimensions.name: reader_quality
dimensions.question: Does the result read like an authored research deliverable with clear structure, continuity, and useful density?

review_rule: Score independently before any condition mapping is revealed. A reviewer may record a tie. Writing style can make condition guessing possible, so this is label-blinded rather than fully blinded.
